wanted_details.heading: Sanctions-designation details
wanted_details.status: Designated by OFAC on January 16, 2025 under Executive Order 13722, program tag DPRK3, for acting or purporting to act for or on behalf of Korea Osong Shipping Corporation

details.label: Linked to
details.value: Korea Osong Shipping Corporation, a.k.a. Osong Shipping Company

details.label: Name in Korean-language reporting
details.value: 송경식, which romanizes as Song Kyong Sik rather than the Son Kyong Sik that OFAC publishes. Radio Free Asia and the Korea Ilbo both name 송경식 as the Korea Osong Shipping representative designated alongside 정인철 on the same day, so the person is the same and the two renderings of the surname differ.

wanted_details.caution: Son Kyong Sik is the Shenyang, China-based chief representative of Department 53's Korea Osong Shipping Co. Department 53 front company Korea Osong Shipping Co has maintained delegations of DPRK IT workers in Laos since at least 2022. As directed by their on-site supervisors, these workers have used aliases to communicate with clients and generate revenue for the DPRK regime, on IT projects such as cryptocurrency exchanges, website and mobile applications.
